chunks: And Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Isma'il ibn Hammam al-Kindi, from al-Rida عليه السلام, who said:
Tayammum is one strike for the face and one strike for the palms.

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمُ: tayammum, the dry ablution performed in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl (ritual bath) under specific conditions
key_terms.ضَرْبَةٌ: a strike, meaning one placing or striking of the hands upon earth or dust for tayammum
key_terms.لِلْكَفَّيْنِ: for the palms, indicating the hands to be wiped in tayammum
key_terms.لِلْوَجْهِ: for the face, indicating the part wiped in tayammum

ai.seo_question: How many strikes are required in tayammum according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prescribed number of strikes in tayammum. It indicates that tayammum consists of one strike for the face and one strike for the palms, making it a concise legal ruling on ritual purity.
